home.aboutSubtitle: Built on Experience. Distinguished by Precision.
home.aboutBody:
Cedar Stone is more than just a stone manufacturing facility; it is a professional journey spanning over thirty-five years in every aspect of the natural stone industry. Our story began in 1990 under the name "PIRAMID Stone Carving and Construction Company," and since then, we have been dedicated to delivering stone products that combine superior quality with exceptional craftsmanship.

We believe that every piece of natural stone possesses a unique character. For this reason, we are committed to enhancing its natural beauty through expert stone cutting, polishing, shaping, and finishing processes supported by decades of experience and modern technologies.

Over the years, we have built strong and lasting relationships with homeowners, contractors, real estate developers, interior designers, and owners of commercial and hospitality projects. Today, the Cedar Stone name stands as a symbol of quality, reliability, commitment, and timely project execution.

industryDescriptions.interiorDesigners: We work as a trusted partner for interior designers, transforming creative concepts and design visions into custom stone elements that add character, elegance, and uniqueness to every project.
industryDescriptions.hospitality: We manufacture and execute natural stone works for hotels, resorts, and hospitality developments, combining luxury, durability, and long-term performance.

process.body: We carefully select premium natural stone from a variety of trusted sources to ensure exceptional quality, consistency, and aesthetic appeal in every project.
We provide precision stone cutting and fabrication services tailored to the exact requirements of each project, whether for façades, flooring, staircases, or custom architectural elements.

Every project has its own character. We offer a variety of surface finishes—including polished, smooth, antique, bush-hammered, rough, and hand-carved—to complement different architectural styles and design requirements.
Our expertise extends to natural stone façades, indoor and outdoor flooring, wall cladding, and architectural applications that combine timeless aesthetics with long-lasting performance.

Beyond standard products, we create bespoke architectural elements—including columns, balustrades, fireplace surrounds, thresholds, sills, and decorative stone features—crafted to meet the unique vision of every project.
